sections.title: 1. Cell Theory & Eukaryotic vs Prokaryotic Basics

masteryZone.q: Which of the following lacks a cellular structure?
masteryZone.sol: Viruses are acellular (lacking cellular structure) and behave as particles outside host cells.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Mycoplasma has a peptidoglycan cell wall.
masteryZone.sol: False. Mycoplasma is unique among bacteria because it completely lacks a cell wall.

masteryZone.q: The phrase 'Omnis cellula e cellula' was coined by Rudolf ________.
masteryZone.sol: Rudolf Virchow added the cell lineage concept to Cell Theory in 1855.

masteryZone.q: Which organelle is the site of cellular protein factories?
masteryZone.sol: Ribosomes are protein factories of the cell, translating mRNA into polypeptide chains.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Chloroplasts and Mitochondria contain 70S ribosomes.
masteryZone.sol: True. Both organelles have bacterial ancestry and contain 70S ribosomes and circular DNA.

masteryZone.q: The single membrane bounding the plant vacuole is the ________.
masteryZone.sol: The tonoplast regulates molecular transport between cytoplasm and plant vacuole.

masteryZone.q: During Meiosis, crossing over occurs in which stage?
masteryZone.sol: Crossing over (homologous recombination) takes place during the Pachytene stage of Prophase I.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Acrocentric chromosomes form a V-shape during anaphase.
masteryZone.sol: False. Metacentric chromosomes form a V-shape. Acrocentric chromosomes form a J-shape.

masteryZone.q: The shortest stage of mitotic division is ________.
masteryZone.sol: Anaphase is the shortest stage of mitosis, lasting only a few minutes.
